name: plugin-spike
$tagsComment: Decision 5's spike (docs/business-apps/spikes/plugins-decision-5.md), and nothing may depend on it: no depConstraint in eslint.config.mjs lists `type:spike`, and no rule has `type:spike` as its source, so in the file types that rule reads it may depend on no project of the workspace either. scripts/beta-harness/module-boundaries.mjs proves both with probes, refuses to pass unless this list is exactly ['type:spike'], and fails on any target Nx resolves here, inferred ones included, beyond tests, lint and the type check. checkPluginSpikeIsolated in scripts/review-guardrails.mjs fails on any reference to or link into this directory from the rest of the repository, on a declared target beyond test, lint and typecheck, on key material here, and on an import here of anything but these files, Node's built-ins, Vitest and Playwright, which covers the .mjs sources the boundary rule does not read.

lint.$comment: Declared rather than inferred: @nx/eslint/plugin infers `eslint:lint`, which `nx affected -t lint` does not match (see tools/satori-generators/project.json).

typecheck.$comment: Vitest strips types without checking them, and the sources are JavaScript with JSDoc types, so this is the only type check. No `build` target, on purpose: the spike is never built into anything.
